messages:
sara_cs: Heads up — GlowHealth flagged an org-level ask this morning: analytics + personalization teams want to start sending high-throughput embedding and chat traffic next month. They asked for guidance on dedicated capacity.
omar_se: Nice. Do we have numbers? qps estimates?
sara_cs: Customer estimates 150 reqs/s embedding batch + 50 r/s chat peak, avg seq length 512. They'll ramp over 4 weeks.
jules_re: Marking renewal watch — renewal in 90 days. This could be an upsell if we nail capacity/pricing.
tom_support: Repro'd usage pattern in staging with a quick load run. Latency ok on current shared nodes but KV cache warmup is slow.
kai_infra: We should pre-warm a 2-GPU dedicated pool + enable prefix caching. I'll open a provisioning ticket.
kai_infra: ticket created: infra-4562 — reserve 2xA100 for glowhealth pilot. ETA 2 business days.
omar_se: Recommend offering a Dedicated pilot proposal: committed monthly throughput + overage pricing. I'll draft numbers.
sara_cs: Can someone run a quick cost delta calc vs hosted per-token? Need to show potential savings.
omar_se: Quick snippet I used:
```
# estimate
qps=150
tokens_per_req=300
monthly_tokens=qps*tokens_per_req*3600*24*30
```
use this to model committed vs payg.
jules_re: Also capture enablement request: two 1-hr workshops (embed tuning, prompt engineering) + runbook for ops.
sara_cs: Scheduling enablement: Wed 10am PT works for customer. @omar_se @tom_support pls confirm.
tom_support: I'm in. I'll prepare a troubleshooting playbook and monitoring dashboard link: https://console.redwood/teams/glowhealth/boards/ops
sara_cs: Flagging renewal risk if onboarding delays >2 weeks — customer said timelines are tight.
omar_se: I'll include a discount path for committed capacity in the proposal; also propose a 30-day canary with SLAs.
sara_cs: Action items: kai create infra ticket (done), omar draft proposal (due EOD tomorrow), tom prepare dashboard + workshop slides. I'll own customer comms and renewal watch.
sara_cs: capture feedback from pilot: embed quality, latency SLOs, error rate by model variant — we'll add to customer health doc.
deploy-bot: infra-4562 state changed: provisioning in progress (2xA100 scheduled)
sara_cs: thanks — keep updates here. :thumbsup:
